notes:
First public release of YMP – YouTube Moderator Panel.

Features
- Real-time live chat with automatic reconnect, @ mentions, emoji bar and search
- Moderation per message: delete, timeout (5 min) and ban
- New and known viewers per streamer channel, with membership and subscription status
- Greetings and farewells in three variants (standard, subscribers, non-subscribers), sent manually or automatically
- Custom quick actions that send a text to the chat with one click
- Livestream next to the chat or in a pop-out window, with stream history and favorites
- Onboarding, backup and restore, English and German interface, dark themes
- In-app updates: Stable or Beta channel, automatic check every 4–48 hours, one-click install
